title: Sfumato in Interior Paintings
content: TheThe Siestaby Jehan Georges Vibert shows a rustic inn in Spain.Jehan Georges VibertThe siesta (La Sieste), 1862The level of finish and the soft lighting seem inspired by seventeenth-century Dutch still life painting.Painted when he was just 22 years old, this was Jehan Georges Vibert's first painting exhibited at the Paris Salon, and it was later exhibited in England, where it led to his popularity there.
